svg.aria-label: I build backends that stay up when traffic stops behaving. Here's how I got here, one chapter at a time. The first compile (2023): Started a CSE degree at Nirma University with a minor in Adaptive AI. The early semesters went into fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and plenty of LeetCode and Codeforces problems. Paper to production (2024): An engineering business in Ahmedabad still ran inventory, orders and production tracking on paper. I built them an ERP from scratch and own every part of it: requirements, architecture, database design, deploys and maintenance. 20+ people use it every day, and it taught me that production is where the real requirements show up. Founding engineer (2026): Joined an AI startup incubated at Nirma's E-Cell as its founding backend engineer. I owned the backend end to end, from service design and data modelling to containerised deploys and CI/CD, and put agentic AI, LLM and deep-learning services behind production REST APIs for healthcare and fintech products. Asking satellites questions (2026): That summer, at ISRO's National Remote Sensing Centre, I built VYOM: an agentic GIS system you question in plain language, which works through ResourceSat-2/2A imagery to answer. Through a QGIS plugin it automated flood, wildfire, drought and landslide analysis across 6 disaster events and 300+ satellite scenes. What's next (now): Final year, and still the engineer behind the ERP. Next I want a team where the hard part is keeping systems correct and fast under real load. Meanwhile I'm digging into distributed systems internals: queues, consensus and orchestration.

svg.text: I build backends that stay up when traffic stops behaving.
Here's how I got here, one chapter at a time.
NIRMA UNIVERSITY · B.TECH CSE, MINOR IN ADAPTIVE AI
Started a CSE degree at Nirma University with a minor in Adaptive AI. The early
semesters went into fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and plenty of LeetCode
RADHE ENGINEERING WORKS · LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PART-TIME
An engineering business in Ahmedabad still ran inventory, orders and production tracking
on paper. I built them an ERP from scratch and own every part of it: requirements,
architecture, database design, deploys and maintenance. 20+ people use it every day, and
it taught me that production is where the real requirements show up.
ATLAS AI LABS · FOUNDING ENGINEER, BACKEND · SSIP 2.0 GRANTEE
Joined an AI startup incubated at Nirma's E-Cell as its founding backend engineer. I
owned the backend end to end, from service design and data modelling to containerised
deploys and CI/CD, and put agentic AI, LLM and deep-learning services behind production
REST APIs for healthcare and fintech products.
NRSC, ISRO · AI SYSTEMS ENGINEERING INTERN · HYDERABAD
That summer, at ISRO's National Remote Sensing Centre, I built VYOM: an agentic GIS
system you question in plain language, which works through ResourceSat-2/2A imagery to
answer. Through a QGIS plugin it automated flood, wildfire, drought and landslide
analysis across 6 disaster events and 300+ satellite scenes.
FINAL YEAR · OPEN TO BACKEND & SYSTEMS ROLES
Final year, and still the engineer behind the ERP. Next I want a team where the hard
part is keeping systems correct and fast under real load. Meanwhile I'm digging into
distributed systems internals: queues, consensus and orchestration.
